value.rationale: The multiplication orbit of an established natural prime-nondivisibility index set has a sharp topological and arithmetic threshold: each of two small ratios permits exactly 3^r two-point orbits per length-r base-25 block, forming uncountable positive-dimensional Cantor sets, while every nonzero third point is forbidden. Ratio 4 has a positive length-three witness, showing this is the precise first-ratio boundary. This is not merely the source digit test or an arbitrary finite tabulation.
